scope: Own single-metric purchase summary bar graph; category subset and single legend color.
source_basis: Observed Filter/ApplyF8/Close and category/legend checkbox groups; new public GraphFilter body analyzed with actualREA.
selection: Full axis tuple key, retains successful report order; unlike original caption-matching loops this does not merge repeated labels. Require category and one legend.
colors: Own strict6hex legend color, in-memory staging copy. Original category color picker, palette and exact category/legend precedence remain unimplemented.
apply: Immediate graph projection/rescaling; no reaggregation/query/document/stock/sequence/allocation/storage write. Full table and CSV stay unchanged. Print shows selected chart, selected/total counts and successful period/metric/basis/color.
cancel: Button/Escape/drop edits destroy staged copy; own cancellation guarantee. Source explicitClose sends no message; alias/base-X/Escape original state restoration not established.
safety: Old popup cannot apply after current result changes. F8 stays inside dialog; navigation/destroy closes it.
restore: Clone selection keys/color separately from pending controls. Requery successful report; prune removed selected keys in BOTH actual graph and saved successful filter; do not reselect reappearing categories. If none remain, clear all report output. Normal fresh query resets all categories/defaultcolor.
legacy: No graphSelection means all current categories and default blue. No stored record/schema change.
